model: IN485HIT001R000 (Hitachi commercial and VRF gateway, BACnet MS/TP)
equipment_type: VRF / split air conditioner BACnet gateway (1 indoor unit or group)
applies_to: Hitachi commercial and VRF indoor units on the AB wired remote-controller bus (one unit or a group that acts as one).
summary: Intesis interface for one Hitachi commercial or VRF indoor unit on the AB remote-controller bus, serving BACnet MS/TP or Modbus RTU (DIP switch). It exposes 35 fixed objects: on/off, mode, setpoint, fan and up/down vane as _command/_status pairs, error code with reset, filter sign with reset, occupancy logic, a remote lock, a virtual-temperature function and a reset-behaviour setting.
notes: Sibling of the INBACHIT001R000 (listed separately); this model adds DIP switch read-backs and the ResetBehaviour object.

The manual's object list gives ErrorAddress as AI 2 (clashes with ErrorCode); its property table says AI 4, used here. The list also spells FilterSignAddress as FilterSingAddress and ResetBehaviour as ResetBehavior; names here follow Object_Name.
FanSpeed_command prints six states (up to Fan Speed 5) while its Present_Value range is 1..5 and FanSpeed_status has five; Fan Speed 5 may not be accepted.
ErrorCodeM has 45 states; the Hitachi error code table is in the manual.
Temperature objects follow the °C/°F DIP switch setting.

source.title: IN485HIT001R000 Gateway - Hitachi Commercial and VRF Systems to BACnet MS/TP and Modbus RTU - User Manual

integration.summary: Connect the gateway anywhere on the AB remote bus, leave the protocol switch on BACnet MS/TP, set the MAC address on SW2 and the bus role on SW1-1, then write the _command objects (on/off, mode, setpoint, fan) and read the _status objects.

minimum_points.name: SetPoint_status
minimum_points.why: Setpoint the unit is really using

integration.enable: No enable point is documented; the gateway accepts commands once it talks to the unit. BV 2 LockRemoteControl locks the wired remote.
integration.remote_sensors: With the gateway as AB-bus header (SW1-1 on), reading temperature from the remote (SW1-2 on) and the unit set to use the remote's sensor, the value written to AO 1 RoomTemperature_command becomes the unit's reference temperature. Otherwise the Virtual Temperature function recalculates the setpoint from AO 1 (BI 14 shows it is active, AI 17 the BMS setpoint).
setup: Protocol DIP switch: BACnet MS/TP (default) or Modbus RTU; autobaud is the default MS/TP baud rate.
Device instance 246000 + the MS/TP MAC address on SW2, unless Object_Identifier is written from BACnet (manual addressing until a factory reset).
SW1-1: follower on the AB bus (default) or header. With no wired remote installed, set the gateway as header.
MV 4 ResetBehaviour chooses whether the last on/off, mode, fan, vane and setpoint values are restored after a gateway reset.
gotchas: If a Hitachi wired remote is on the bus, one of the two must be header and the other follower.
The Occupancy MV and its four setpoint AVs drive built-in logic; leave Occupancy at 3 (Disabled) if the BMS handles scheduling.
Write the _command object and read the _status object.
